note: Bundled compatibility list used to suppress false-positive Palworld version-mismatch warnings. 'known_versions' is the fast fingerprint path (Steam buildid + Pal-Windows.pak size, no pak content read, checked at every GUI startup). 'known_vanilla_manifest_sha256' is the self-judgment path: the combined_hash from extract_vanilla.py's vanilla_manifest.json (sha256 over the small extracted output set, not the full pak). Compatibility data is read only from this bundled file and is never extended over the network.
